solver.objective: J = sum_active((Re(dZ)/sigma)^2+(Im(dZ)/sigma)^2)/(2*N_active) + beta*sum(diff(log(rho))^2)/(N_layers-1); prior=0 for one layer
solver.sigma_definition: standard deviation of each independent real and imaginary part

objective.definition: J = sum_active((Re(dZ)/sigma)^2+(Im(dZ)/sigma)^2)/(2*N_active) + beta*sum(diff(log(rho))^2)/(N_layers-1); prior=0 for one layer

identifiability.kind: data-only local linearized identifiability, conditional on fixed thickness
identifiability.caveat: Linearization excludes thickness, dimensionality, correlated noise and static-shift uncertainty; not a uniqueness proof.

target.provenance: inverted supplied EDI; layer thickness imposed by operator, no measured geology target

evaluation.criteria: component WRMS <=1.5, finite solve, plus data-only local identifiability; no geology truth supplied

uncertainty.conditioning: Selected TRF resistivity, fixed thickness, fixed independent complex-Gaussian errors, acquisition, bounds and regularization
uncertainty.interval_method: pointwise percentile, not simultaneous or posterior
uncertainty.sampling_law: independent Gaussian real and imaginary errors with supplied fixed sigma
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional repeatability only: excludes structural, thickness, dimensionality and correlated-noise errors.

compatibility.criteria: diagonal component WRMS <=3 and conservative antisymmetry WRMS <=3
compatibility.caveat: Necessary 1D consistency screen only, not proof of isotropy; static shift and 2D/3D ambiguity remain.

provenance.preflight: strict full-impedance EDI with optional validated ancillary tipper v2
provenance.sigma_definition: SD per real or imaginary component
provenance.error_assumption: equal real/imag variance and zero real-imag covariance; no component covariance invented
provenance.rotation_action: none; tensor and marginal errors remain in supplied common frame

info.CAOS.PROVENANCE: Independent analytic half-space or two-layer reflection formula; no field acquisition
